_comment: Model line-up. provider: gemini | cerebras | mistral | nvidia | openrouter | groq | together | ollama | mock. 'benchmark': true = default comparison set (open-weight only). 'reference': true = closed model, optional comparison point, never counted as one of the open models. 'extra' = provider-specific request fields; unsupported ones are dropped automatically. Google retired Gemma 3 from the Gemini API in 2026; only the two Gemma 4 models remain there (Gemma 3 still runs locally via Ollama). Check which models your keys can reach with: python -m app.check_models

models.label: gemma-4-31b
